warnings: Private catamaran fares (≈₹1,200‑₹1,600 per person) are high in peak season; book 2‑4 weeks in advance to lock price.
Rough sea conditions can cause motion sickness; consider avomine tablets and choose the fastest catamaran.
Limited cash facilities on Havelock and Neil (single SBI ATM often out of cash); carry ₹10,000‑₹15,000 per person from Port Blair.
Medical services are basic on Havelock; serious issues require evacuation to Port Blair—ensure travel insurance covers emergency evacuation.
Seafood‑dominant menus; vegetarians should specifically request "no spice" or "vegetarian" dishes, as options are limited.
Neil Island has few restaurant choices; pack some non‑perishable meals from Havelock as a backup.

Boat operator pricing inflation: Government ferries cost ₹300–500/person, while private catamarans cost ₹800–1,200/person. During peak season (Oct–Feb) walk‑in tickets are often unavailable; book 2–4 weeks ahead via makruzz.com or andamans.nic.in to secure fair pricing and seats.
Rough seas warning: The Andaman Sea is one of the rougher ferry routes. Motion‑sickness is possible; carry avomine tablets and select the fastest catamaran to minimise time on the water.
ATM cash shortage: The sole SBI ATM on Havelock (near Beach 5 market) frequently runs out of cash on peak‑season weekends. Carry ₹10,000–15,000 per person from Port Blair to avoid being stranded.
Limited medical facilities: Havelock has only a small health centre; serious medical needs require air‑lift to Port Blair. Purchase travel insurance with emergency evacuation coverage.
Seafood‑dominant cuisine: most restaurants focus on fish, prawns and lobster; vegetarian dishes are available but limited—request "no spice" if you prefer milder food.
Cash‑only economy: Outside Port Blair cards are rarely accepted; bring sufficient cash for ferry tickets, ATM withdrawals, and meals on Havelock and Neil.
Reef‑safe sunscreen required: Regular sunscreen is discouraged; use reef‑safe products to protect coral reefs.
Mosquito‑borne dengue risk: Pack effective repellent and consider wearing long sleeves in the evenings.
Limited dining on Neil: Restaurant options are few; plan to have meals stocked from Havelock or carry packaged foods as a fallback.
